serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table for bookedMin (capacity_bookings Order / maintenance_bookings / unassigned_services), service_capacities reserved_minutes as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin = modelled service minutes set aside for the bucket that day; bookedMin = the bucket's authoritative booked minutes; ledgerBookedMin = the service_capacities reserved figure, kept only so its lag against bookedMin stays visible and never used as the booked side; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series - the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until the lot is edited; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity' (a pickup+swap ceiling, not an all-order one); null means not configured, not a ceiling of zero
